problems: The bottom of the door frame runs into the ring of lights. The torus reaches down to z≈0.356 and the lights sit at z=0.36, so the front lights are buried in the frame and the ring doesn't read as a clean band around the frame.
The shell and the glass door look faceted, like a disco ball, because the lathe profiles have too few points (33 and 21). The restyle could keep those facets as tiles.

Once the light ring is lowered so it clears the door, the legs would come out of the shell exactly at the ring. Their tops have to move lower and further in so they come out of the underside below the ring.
